en:
It wouldn't matter where the arrow hit...
if it were poisoned.
P-Poison?

I noticed something about the poison in
my lab during the investigation.

There was just a little less
in the bottle than before.

If that poison had been applied
to those arrows...

they would have been lethal, no matter
where they connected.
...Maki, do you have a rebuttal?

Wh-What's the matter?
Why don't you say anything?

Don't tell me...
Are you...really the culprit?

Th-There's no way she is!
Cuz...why would she kill Kaito!?

Nyeeeh! I can't understand if
you don't explain anything!
Maki...is still fighting.
Huh? Fighting?

Do you remember that Maki said <CLT=cltSTRONG>she
would do anything to defeat Kokichi<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Maki is trying to kill Kokichi
in this class trial.

She wants to kill the mastermind,
a Remnant of Despair!

Then when Maki said she would
sacrifice anything, she meant...

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>sacrifice<CLT=cltMIND> that Maki
is talking about must be...
Maki's life
Maki plans to sacrifice her life.

Let's assume Maki is really the culprit, and
we make the wrong verdict...

We'll all die because we couldn't point
to the real culprit...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Shuichi's life
Maki plans to sacrifice...me.

...No, there is no reason for only you to
die, Shuichi.

If we cannot correctly identify the culprit,
everyone but the culprit will lose their lives.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kaito's life
She intends to give up Kaito's life.

Kaito's life...?
But Kaito is already...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
All of us
If we can't choose the correct culprit...

Then everyone but the culprit will be
killed...
So...does that mean the culprit...is Shuichi!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>The sacrifice Maki is talking about...

She plans to sacrifice <CLT=cltSTRONG>all of our lives<CLT=cltNORMAL>
in order to kill Kokichi...
Sacrifice us?

Then by hiding the truth, Maki was trying
to get us to arrive at the wrong answer...

just to kill Kokichi, and the rest of us
along with him?

So doesn't that mean that
Maki's the culprit?

She knew what happened and
tried to hide it from us...

But that mischievous plan was ruined
alllll thanks to Shuichi here.

Too bad, Maki!
I already predicted this would happen.

You knew all along that Maki was the culprit.
That's why you've been so calm.
This isn't over.
Hmmm?

Maybe we do have the truth now, but
this isn't over.

We have a choice to make. We don't have
to follow where the evidence leads.
Huh? What do you mean?

Does this mean...you're gonna vote for someone
else, even if it's not the truth?

Someone else... You mean vote incorrectly
on purpose!?

Someone else... You mean vote incorrectly
on purpose!?
Wh-What did you say?

Kaito told me that only I would be able to
grasp what lies beyond the truth.

That means finding the truth is not enough.
We need to grasp the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL> just beyond it.

So, Maki...please tell us the truth!
The truth that only you know!
So Kaito...said that to you.

Then...does that mean you guys made up
before he died?
Yeah... When I went to see him yesterday.
I see...

...Okay, I'll talk about it. Especially since
it's my responsibility for involving everyone.

Shuichi...you're so persistent.
Were you always like that?

Ah, you think so? Maybe Kaito's charisma
is starting to rub off on me...
That guy...could be pretty stubborn.
Then...what really happened?
Maki, please tell us.
Please!

And so, Maki began telling the truth.
A truth that would leave us all in shock!

Don't just start narrating things! 
You're ruining the mood!

Well...I guess this turn of events isn't
exactly boring, either.
